user.title: Zigbee map
user.description: Enter one zigbee2mqtt base topic per line. Each must match the `mqtt.base_topic` of that zigbee2mqtt instance, for example `zigbee2mqtt`, `zigbee2mqtt2`, `zigbee2mqtt3`. An instance that is not running yet can be listed already: it shows as unavailable until it appears.

error.invalid_topics: Enter at least one base topic.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Zigbee map is already configured. Add further zigbee2mqtt instances through the Configure button instead.

init.title: Zigbee map options
init.description: Add or remove zigbee2mqtt base topics. The integration reloads after saving.

error.invalid_topics: Enter at least one base topic.

update.name: Update
update.description: Requests a fresh network map from zigbee2mqtt. Without a network, every configured base topic is asked.

network.name: Network
network.description: Base topic of the zigbee2mqtt instance to refresh. Omit to refresh every configured instance.
